faq.a: Mohamed is associated with the Arabic form مَحَمَّد, whose core sense is mohamed; muhammad.

faq.q: What is the origin of Mohamed?
faq.a: Mohamed is associated with Arabic. Mohamed is a common spelling of Arabic مُحَمَّد (Muḥammad), meaning 'praised'.
Yes — the underlying form مَحَمَّد is Arabic.
Mohamed can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Arabic-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
Mohamed should not be classified as a Quranic personal name without a direct Quranic basis. Muḥammad is not a Quranic personal name, though the root ح م د is Quranic.

faq.q: What does Mohamed mean in Urdu?
faq.a: In Urdu, Mohamed is rendered محمد and carries the sense محمد، تعریف شدہ.

faq.q: What does Mohamed mean in Persian?
faq.a: In Persian, Mohamed is rendered محمد and carries the sense محمد، ستوده.
A romanized syllable approximation is mo-ha-med. No IPA transcription is asserted because a verified phonetic transcription was not available.

faq.q: What are the variants of Mohamed?
faq.a: Romanization variants include Mohamed, mohamed. Script forms are محمد, مَحَمَّد, मोहम्मद.

faq.q: Is Mohamed a boy's or girl's name?
faq.a: Documented usage records this form as male. Gender is not inferred from the meaning of the word, and actual use may vary between communities.
